task: Audit joinspec.md for behavioral reproducibility. Determine whether an implementation of joinspec.md, authored solely from joinspec.md, reproduces joiner.py on every probe in probes.json — and report every behavior exercised by the probes that joinspec.md either does not determine or determines differently from joiner.py.
evidence_requirements: E-A: a statement of every behavior on the probe set where joinspec.md either does not determine the output or determines it differently from joiner.py, or an explicit argument that none exists

E-B: an item-level comparison over probes.json between joiner.py and an implementation of joinspec.md authored solely from joinspec.md, by an author who has never accessed joiner.py nor any analysis derived from it; the implementation must be a python file exposing join_items(items) so the comparison is mechanically reproducible
E-C: the verdict follows from E-A and E-B together: DIVERGES iff the comparison shows a differing output on some probe
